notifications.message: The network lacks dedicated routing devices and firewalls. A Cisco 2960 (Layer 2 switch) is identified as the potential gateway for the 'security' zone (192.168.1.0/26). A Layer 2 switch is highly unsuitable for a core network role, especially for a zone designated for security, as it lacks advanced security features (stateful inspection, IPS/IDS), performance for routing, and robust policy enforcement capabilities of a dedicated firewall or Layer 3 router.
notifications.title: Notification

notifications.message: Only one VLAN (VLAN 10) and one subnet (192.168.1.0/26) are defined, both associated with a 'security' zone. This indicates a severe lack of network segmentation. Without further segmentation (e.g., for management, user, guest, server, DMZ), a compromise in one area could easily spread across the entire network, violating the principle of least privilege and increasing the attack surface.
notifications.title: Notification

notifications.message: VLAN 10 is named 'service' but is assigned to the 'security' zone. This inconsistency can lead to confusion, misconfiguration, and errors when applying security policies or troubleshooting.

notifications.message: The subnet 192.168.1.0/26 has a planned gateway of 192.168.1.1 (CORE-SW's IP). However, no SVI (Switch Virtual Interface) for VLAN 10 is discovered on CORE-SW. notifications.message: No Access Control Lists (ACLs) were discovered on CORE-SW. Given the high security priority, the complete absence of ACLs means there are no granular traffic filtering rules in place to restrict communication between devices or to/from the network, leaving it highly vulnerable to unauthorized access, lateral movement, and various network attacks.

notifications.message: The Cisco 2960 (CORE-SW) is primarily a Layer 2 switch, but it is designated as the gateway (192.168.1.1) for the 192.168.1.0/26 subnet (associated with VLAN 10). For it to function as a gateway for client devices and perform inter-VLAN routing, it must be a Layer 3 switch with 'ip routing' enabled and an SVI ('interface vlan 10') configured with the gateway IP. The current report shows no SVIs configured (due to unreachability), and the device model typically lacks full L3 routing capabilities.

notifications.message: No trunk configurations could be verified on CORE-SW due to its unreachability. Trunks are essential for VLAN propagation across the network and their absence or misconfiguration can lead to significant connectivity issues and segmentation failures.
